headline: Last big week closed out; nothing left but the taper
narrative: The final big week of the plan is in the bank, and it finished just over its vert target with time on feet running a little past its ask too. The shape was back-loaded: an easy Monday run, a flat Wednesday outing and a trio of weights sessions up front, then Thursday's double Hollie's Loop in the rain — hard first lap, easy second plus an extra hill — did the heavy lifting. Friday's steep treadmill block, Saturday's Lyme parkrun and recovery loop in far kinder conditions, and Sunday's Beacon Hill reps, explicitly logged as the remaining vert for the week, closed it out with no drama.

Injury watch stays quiet: no mention of the right quad on descents, the adductor or the calf all week, and no flags — encouraging given a hard-lap descent and a racy parkrun finish. Peak phase is complete and everything the Costa Blanca build needed is banked. From Monday the taper bites: cut the volume, keep a few sharp touches, and remember the target is now a ceiling — overshooting it is the failure.
